title: Media
intro: Images uploaded from the post editor or the cover field. An image used in a post body or as a cover cannot be deleted.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to delete this image.
errors.inUse: This image is used in a post body or as a cover, so it cannot be deleted. Remove it from the posts first.
errors.objectRemains: The image record was deleted, but the file could not be removed from Storage. Try again or notify an administrator.
errors.rateLimited: Too many images were deleted in a short time (at most 60 per 10 minutes). Try again shortly.
errors.failed: The action could not be completed. Try again.

loadError: The media list could not be loaded.
listDescription: The bucket is public: anyone who knows a file address can open the image, including images used in drafts. Authors can delete only their own uploads; editors and admins can delete any unused image.

upload.tooLarge: The file can be at most {max} MB.
upload.unsupportedType: Only JPEG, PNG, WebP, and GIF images can be uploaded.
upload.invalidDimensions: Image dimensions must be between 1 and 10000 pixels.
upload.rejected: The upload was rejected. Check your permissions or try again in a few minutes (at most 20 images per 10 minutes).
upload.registerFailed: The image could not be saved. Try again.
